name: H05_hare_apparent_counts_creatures_only
note: Hare Apparent: 'the number of other CREATURES you control named Hare Apparent'. P0 controls a permanent named Hare Apparent that is not a creature (a land, as a permanent turned into a land by an effect would be) and no other Hare Apparent creature: casting a Hare Apparent counts nothing, so no Rabbit is created. With a real Hare Apparent creature beside it the count is exactly one.
